start: Gym tab, a member using the app with no gym joined; the gym's 6-letter code in hand

steps.action: Open the Gym tab
user_sees: Card heading 'Join your gym'
'Got a code from your gym? Join to check in, order from its shop, and see the app in its colours. Your workouts stay as they are.'
'Scan the poster' as the first button
'Or type your gym's code' above a box '6 letters or numbers'
must_not: The typed-code box shown above 'Scan the poster'
The card shown when a gym is already joined

steps.action: Type the code in small letters in the box
user_sees: The code in capitals, in the wide code look
No more than 6 letters or numbers
must_not: Small letters kept
Spaces or dashes kept in the code
A seventh character accepted

steps.action: Tap 'Next' (spoken 'Join with this code')
user_sees: The invite screen for that code, showing the gym and asking before joining
must_not: The member joined without saying yes
Workouts changed or removed
The gym's colours put on before joining

start: Gym tab, no gym joined, at the gym's desk in front of the poster

steps.action: Tap 'Scan the poster'
user_sees: The camera scanner screen
'Point your camera at the QR code on the poster at your gym's desk.'
must_not: The typed-code box needed first
A blank camera view with no words

steps.action: Point the camera at the poster's QR code
user_sees: The same invite (or check-in) screen as a typed code, for that gym
must_not: Joining with no question
A different gym's invite screen

start: Profile tab, Settings, no gym joined

steps.action: Tap Settings, look at the 'Your gym' group
user_sees: Row 'Join your gym' with the line 'Type your gym's code or scan its poster'
must_not: A 'Leave' row when no gym is joined

steps.action: Tap 'Join your gym'
user_sees: The Gym tab opens (switches tab) with the 'Join your gym' card at the top
must_not: A second Gym page stacked on top of Settings
The back arrow landing on a blank page

start: WhatsApp message from the gym with its invite link; Gym tab, no gym joined

steps.action: Copy the whole WhatsApp message and paste it in the code box
user_sees: Only the gym's 6-letter code in the box
must_not: The whole message pasted in the box
Letters of the message taken as the code

steps.action: Tap 'Next'
user_sees: The invite screen for that gym
must_not: An error for a link that holds a good code

steps.action: Type 4 letters and tap 'Next'
user_sees: Under the box: 'The code is 6 letters or numbers. Ask at your gym's desk.'
The line is spoken by the screen reader
must_not: The invite screen opens
A pop-up instead of the line under the box

steps.action: Tap 'Next' with the box empty
user_sees: The same line under the box
must_not: The app moves on with no code

steps.action: Type a 6-letter code no gym has and tap 'Next'
user_sees: 'We couldn't find this gym'
'No gym has the code {code}, so scan the poster at your gym or type your gym's code again.'
must_not: The member joined to some gym
The word 'link' in the message
An endless spinner

start: Gym tab, no gym joined, the error line showing under the box

steps.action: Type one more letter in the box
user_sees: The error line goes at once
must_not: The old error still showing while typing

steps.action: Join the gym on the invite screen, come back to the Gym tab
user_sees: The gym's own screen; the 'Join your gym' card is gone
must_not: The 'Join your gym' card still at the top after joining

steps.action: Leave the gym from Settings ('Leave {gym name}') and open the Gym tab
user_sees: The 'Join your gym' card is back, with an empty box
must_not: The old code still filled in
Workouts gone after leaving

steps.action: Type a gym's code and tap 'Next', then go back without joining
user_sees: The Gym tab again, still with no gym
must_not: The gym gets the member's name or number before the member says yes
The member listed in the gym's panel

steps.action: Join on the invite screen
user_sees: The app in the gym's colours; 'Your workouts stay as they are.' holds
must_not: Workouts sent to the gym without the member's choice
Another gym's name or logo shown
